propositions: The test fails deterministically on hosts with scc or lizard installed because the metric tool resolves and returns no findings below the fixture threshold, yielding no metric evidence record.
The test asserts a metric backend is always present without controlling optional metric-tool availability, leaving it coupled to PATH contents.
The sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already uses explicit _METRIC_CANDIDATES fixture control to force missing-tool scenarios; the full-account test missed this same control.
After applying the missing-metric-tool fixture control, the test deterministically observes the contractual skipped/no_tool record and passes on all supported hosts.
Production grounding behavior and the evidence schema remain unchanged; no fabrication of matches or absences occurs.
The fix is test-only with no production caller or behavioral dependency changes.
